title: Princess turned General
description: It was a long, hard road for Leia Organa. Daughter of Anakin Skywalker, a.k.a. Darth Vader, the Princess of Alderaan had fought tyranny all her life, first taking Palpatine's Empire, then decades later, the similarly ruthless First Order. Personal tragedy offset this freedom fighter's great victories, with her own son, the child of her husband Han Solo, degenerating into the force of evil known as Kylo Ren. Leia and Han would have time to discuss this grim reality before a new mission called Solo into action once again.
